get.description: Participants and their Player Identities, the Best-of or Bout count, Bouts already completed (to resume after an Abort) and which Participants have forfeited.

put.description: Head-to-head: the winner. Free-for-all: a strict placement and points for every Participant still playing. Repeating an identical report is harmless; a different one conflicts. A Bout already forfeited can't be reported. Recorded Bouts can be retried after the Match completes while the token remains valid for the latest allocation.

post.description: Each No-show forfeits the Bout. Both head-to-head Participants missing is a double Forfeit.

get.description: The Game Server address and port are included only for the Match's Participants and the Organizer.

post.description: The Organizer awards a win, or a double Forfeit. This is the only manual way to set a result.
Any authenticated user can create a Tournament and becomes its Organizer. A Game backend can create Tournaments for the Games that trust its client.

put.description: TournamentSettings can only change while the Tournament is a Draft; they freeze once registration opens. A Tournament declared by a Tournament Manifest is edited in git instead, and refused here with declared-in-git.

post.description: The Organizer can cancel at any point before completion. Pending Matches stop and their Game Servers are released.

A person registers their own Keycloak identity (the default), or a linked identity exposed as a claim. A trusted Game backend can register any Player Identity of a kind the Game accepts. First come, first served up to the Capacity, only during the Registration Window. Registering during the Check-in Window checks in too.

get.description: The caller's Participants in the Tournament, one per Player Identity they own: whether they are registered and checked in.

post.summary: Check in during the Check-in Window

post.description: The Organizer removes a Participant, who forfeits every Bout they haven't completed.
The Participant forfeits every Bout they haven't completed, including in a Match already In Progress.

get.description: Empty until the Tournament completes. Participants knocked out in the same elimination Round share a range.
Everything a frontend needs to draw brackets and tables. Game Server addresses are never included; a Match's Participants get theirs from the Match itself.
get.summary: Get a Tournament's Stages, Groups, Rounds, Matches, Bouts and Standings
